wifi.savedHint: The Wi-Fi this server remembers. It hops on by itself whenever they're around.
wifi.loadFail: Couldn't load the saved networks, ngl.
wifi.noneSaved: No saved Wi-Fi yet. Join one and it lands here.
wifi.enterpriseHint: Enterprise network: sign in with a user name and password or a certificate
wifi.forgetMsg: The server stops joining this one by itself. Wanna use it again? Join it and pop the password in.
wifi.forgetMsgActive: The server's on this network rn and will drop off it. If this page reaches you over that Wi-Fi, you'll lose it.
wifi.autoConnectHint: Hop on automatically when it's in range
wifi.priorityHint: Several saved networks around? The highest number wins (-999 to 999)
wifi.priorityRange: Priority has to be a whole number from -999 to 999.
wifi.notEditable: This network got set up outside NoCapOS, so its sign-in can't be changed here. Forget it and join again instead.
wifi.shareAuth: Type your account password to see this network's password and QR code.
wifi.shareScan: Point a phone camera at this to join. Easy.
wifi.shareNoEnterprise: The standard Wi-Fi QR code has no spot for enterprise (802.1X) sign-in, and the newer enterprise QR format barely works on phones. Everyone signs in with their own account instead.
wifi.keepSaved: Leave empty to keep the saved one
wifi.caNoneWarn: No certificate check means a fake access point could snag your password. Not it.
wifi.p12Hint: Got a PKCS#12 (.p12 / .pfx) bundle? Pick it as the client certificate and leave the private key empty.
wifi.certTooBig: That file's too big (64 KB max).
